Quick tech note from the infra side.

High-level tradeoffs (Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private):
- Hosted (US): fastest provisioning (hours), lowest friction. Good for early quality & latency baseline. Shared tenancy but we provide per-tenant isolation and SOC2 logs. Latency: median ~45–85ms per token on our hosted L40 models under test harness.
- Dedicated (EU): recommended if NovaMed requires EU residency or strict throughput SLAs. Provisioning: ~2–3 weeks for GPU pool and routing. Latency: similar medians but more predictable p95. Cost delta: expect ~1.7–2.2x unit cost vs Hosted for reserved capacity depending on commit.
- Private (on-prem / VPC): full control and best for PHI if customer insists on air-gapped requirements. Significant ops + procurement lift; timeline: 6–10 weeks depending on networking/KMS.

Sizing notes for pilot (8-week):
- If you plan 100k tokens/day with 4k max context, Dedicated pool of 2x A100-equivalent nodes recommended for steady-state during peak tests.
- Prefix caching and small-batch streaming will reduce cost; we can provide config suggestions in the PoC.

Flagged risk: if PHI is in-scope and NovaMed cannot accept redacted data for Hosted, expect Private evaluation cadence; we need procurement/security contacts to confirm.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Hosted US pilot start: 2027-01-10 (if NovaMed accepts redacted input for PHI).
- Hosted pilot quality & perf report: 2027-01-31.
- Dedicated EU PoC (if requested): begin provisioning on 2027-01-20, PoC run 2027-02-15 complete.
- Compliance signoff / SOC2 evidence review: 2027-02-28.
- Contract & SOW execution target (close): 2027-03-10.

Decision rules (proposed):
- If NovaMed confirms PHI WILL be redacted for pilot by Jan 7, we proceed with Hosted US pilot on Jan 10.
- If security requires live PHI that cannot be redacted, we move to Dedicated EU PoC track (adds ~3–4 weeks) or Private on-prem evaluation (adds 6–10 weeks).

Cost/effort delta (ballpark for 8-week window):
- Hosted (fastest): baseline pilot cost X (see HubSpot quote).
- Dedicated EU PoC (short-term trial): approx 1.7x–2.0x baseline for the evaluation window — we'll provide a line-item estimate to procurement by Dec 17.
- Private on-prem: material uplift due to infra and networking; estimate on request once we have network/KMS specifics.

Action items:
- Sam: confirm PHI redaction decision and procurement priorities by 2027-01-07.
- NovaMed procurement: confirm required PO/SOW templates and any milestone billing terms.
- Marissa/Vanessa: we'll prepare the contract template and the short Dedicated trial cost breakdown (Marissa will lead).
- Karthik: prepare a one-page tech appendix with the Dedicated sizing and latency expectations (due Dec 17).

If this plan looks good I'll schedule a 30-min working session with procurement + security + Marissa next week to accelerate the SOW.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
